description: Right shift with a sticky bit: shift a right by d and set bit 0 if any 1 bit was shifted out (softfloat_shiftRightJam32)
notes: Berkeley SoftFloat 3 (John R. Hauser), softfloat_shiftRightJam32, inline version (source/include/primitives.h), with uint_fast16_t as uint64_t as on x86-64 glibc. The precondition dist != 0, stated only in a comment in the source, is added as __builtin_assume(d != 0). Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps a branch on d < 31, a shift pair, a compare and a phi: 17 IR instructions (with the assume). Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
